reason: The README describes a monorepo containing several DSH plugins spanning UI panels, debugging, memory, GitHub/Gist synchronization, desktop updates, chat, and desktop overlays; plugin-development is the closest repository-level category, but the collection has no single user-facing purpose and merits human review.

summaries.zh: DSH-Plugs 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件集合，提供界面增强、调试、记忆管理、配置同步、桌面集成和聊天体验等功能。
summaries.en: DSH-Plugs is a collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins providing interface enhancements, debugging, memory management, configuration sync, desktop integration, and chat experiences.

capabilities: Mounts multiple browser and host-side plugins into DSH profiles
Provides a real login-shell PTY terminal panel
Reads and writes local memory, settings, and sync state files
Synchronizes configuration through GitHub Device Flow and secret Gists
Installs DSH runtime updates in place through a desktop bridge
Creates desktop overlays through a DSH-Desktop integration
